title: 院子里的实话  (Truth in the Courtyard)

segments.t: Still beneath the courtyard shade tree at Courtyard Inn in Chengdu, Hao sits down with Qing and Teacher Song to explain Monday night's suitcase mix-up from the beginning. Listen first.
让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，您拿错了她的箱子？
完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
那你为什么晚上把箱子放在台阶上就跑了？
因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
您哥哥就住在成都？
对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果忘了箱子还在这儿！
难怪星期二您打电话请我们别打开白纸包！
白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
'Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!' Doubling 'good' into
好好
before 'look' means 'thoroughly' or 'properly'—take a proper look at you.
真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
'I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.' Everyday disbelief chunk:
不敢相信
literally says 'dare not believe', matching 'I can hardly believe it!'.
完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
'Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.' Useful word
意外
literally 'outside expectation', covers any unplanned surprise or accident.
那你为什么晚上把箱子放在台阶上就跑了？
'Then why did you leave my bag on the step at night and run away?' Notice how 'set on the step then ran' chains two actions smoothly—the second happens the instant the first finishes.
因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
'Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!' Chinese distinguishes older and younger siblings cleanly:
哥哥
always means an older brother, never a younger one.
等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
'Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?' Compact two-syllable word
真名
joins 'real' with 'name' for someone's actual name.
星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果忘了箱子还在这儿！
'Before Friday I wanted a quiet place nearby, and forgot my bag was still here!' Surprise connector
结果
literally 'bear fruit', introduces an unexpected outcome: 'as it turned out'.
白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。

'What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.' Wrapping 'for my brother Zhipeng' inside 'is... one' highlights who the parcel belongs to. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，您拿错了她的箱子？
完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
那你为什么晚上把箱子放在台阶上就跑了？
因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
您哥哥就住在成都？
对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果忘了箱子还在这儿！
难怪星期二您打电话请我们别打开白纸包！
白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
All the puzzle pieces from Monday and Tuesday finally click together. Next time, Hao explains why he has not spoken to his older brother Peng in three years. See you next time.
